# Third-party components

| Component | Version | Source | Licence | Location |
|-----------|---------|--------|---------|----------|
| X-Plane SDK (XPLM headers and Windows import libraries) | 4.3.0 (kXPLM_Version 430; release notes dated 2/21/2026; header banner says "SDK Version: 4.0.0" in XPLMCamera.h). Requires X-Plane 12.4.0 or newer for the 4.3.0 API additions; the plugin defines XPLM200 to XPLM400 only. | https://developer.x-plane.com/sdk/ (official zip) | See `XPSDK/license.txt` (permissive, Laminar Research / Sandy Barbour / Ben Supnik) | `third_party/XPSDK/` |
| doctest | 2.4.11 (DOCTEST_VERSION_MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH in `doctest.h`) | https://github.com/doctest/doctest release 2.4.11, single header | MIT | `third_party/doctest/doctest.h` |
| Dear ImGui | 1.91.5 (`IMGUI_VERSION` in `imgui.h`; tag v1.91.5) | https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/archive/refs/tags/v1.91.5.zip (source zip of the tag) | MIT (`imgui/LICENSE.txt`) | `third_party/imgui/` (core `imgui*.cpp`/`imgui*.h`, `imconfig.h`, `imstb_*.h`, `backends/imgui_impl_opengl2.*`; no examples or docs; `imgui_demo.cpp` is kept but not compiled) |
| Inter (UI text font) | 4.0 (GitHub release v4.0). Only `Inter-Regular.ttf` and `Inter-SemiBold.ttf` are kept, taken from `extras/ttf/` in the zip. | https://github.com/rsms/inter/releases/download/v4.0/Inter-4.0.zip | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/inter/OFL.txt` is the zip's `LICENSE.txt`) | `third_party/fonts/inter/` |
| Material Icons Regular (UI icon font) | google/material-design-icons commit `10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7` (master on the day it was fetched; the 4.0.0 tag has no codepoints file). Files `font/MaterialIcons-Regular.ttf` (356840 bytes) and `font/MaterialIcons-Regular.codepoints`, plus the root `LICENSE`. | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/material-design-icons/10ecc14790612ca8fd164e3f4ffe9c16fc50d5b7/font/MaterialIcons-Regular.ttf (and `.codepoints`, `/LICENSE`) | Apache License 2.0 (`fonts/material/LICENSE`) | `third_party/fonts/material/` |

All were downloaded once and are checked in unchanged. The fonts are not linked: the plugin loads them at runtime from `<plugin folder>/fonts` (copied by the post-build step in `src/plugin/MyKam.vcxproj` and by `deploy.ps1`; licence texts go along as `OFL-Inter.txt` and `LICENSE-MaterialIcons.txt`). Only the icons listed in `src/plugin/ui_theme.h` are put into the font atlas. The Inter zip was fetched with curl.exe because Invoke-WebRequest got a 504 from GitHub's release host. Dear ImGui is compiled into the plugin project only (`src/plugin/MyKam.vcxproj`), never into `mykam_core` or the tests, with warnings relaxed for those files only; the plugin defines `IMGUI_DISABLE_WIN32_FUNCTIONS` and `IMGUI_DISABLE_DEMO_WINDOWS` so it needs no user32 or imm32 and has no demo window, and links `opengl32.lib`. Do not copy any code from other camera plugins (constraint C-08).
